ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
